name: China MIIT
sub: Paused new China AV licenses during a national safety review
about: Chinese ministry central to intelligent connected vehicle policy, pilot-zone approvals and automotive industry regulation. A 2026 draft mandatory standard would require L3 systems to execute a minimal-risk maneuver themselves if the driver fails to respond, an L4-level fallback, and to carry an aircraft-style data recorder, proposed to take effect July 1, 2027.
deployment: China national AV and smart vehicle policy
metrics: Chinese authorities paused new autonomous vehicle licenses amid safety review per Reuters report
